name: @pineappleui/theme
description: Theme providers for @pineappleui — appearance + accent preferences, the Radix Themes wrapper they drive, a global stylesheet, and the first-paint snippet that pre-empts both.

pineapple.refTestNotApplicable: Both exports are providers: ThemePreferencesProvider renders context and no DOM at all, and DesignSystemProvider renders Radix's <Theme> around its children. Each declares its own props rather than extending an element's -- `children` for both, plus ThemePreferencesProvider's optional `storageKey` -- so neither inherits a `ref` the way a wrapper over a DOM primitive does, and neither passes one on. There is no element a consumer could hold a ref to.
